assets.alt: White slide with the Retailworld logo: Employment brand. What's all the fuss? Your employer brand is the engine behind your talent pipeline. Take the health check.

Orange slide, health check: Be honest. Four questions with toggles: Do employee reviews reflect your values? Is your interview process structured, respectful and transparent? Can candidates see what it's really like to work for you? Are your leaders promoting the business online?
White slide: Two or more no's? Your talent pipeline could be leaking. Slower hiring. Higher costs. Reactive recruiting.

Light grey slide, three fixes: Close the gap. 1, audit the reality: ask your best people why they stay. 2, show real stories: swap stock photos for your managers, buyers and floor staff. 3, treat candidates like customers: clear communication at every stage.
Orange slide with the white Retailworld logo: Need a hand? Make hiring your edge. Talk to our specialist retail recruitment team. Link in bio.

assets.alt: White slide with the Retailworld logo: For employers. You didn't lose them on salary. You lost them on speed. A notification from your top candidate: Thanks for your time, but I've accepted another offer.

Orange slide, the 24-hour test: How fast is your hire? Shortlist contacted within 24 to 48 hours, 2 interview stages max, feedback within 24 hours of interview, contract within 24 hours of a verbal yes.
White slide: One no? Your pipeline is leaking. Retail candidates interview with several employers at once. Silence reads as not interested.

Light grey slide, the fix: Treat them like VIPs. Run the candidate experience like a high-value customer journey. Set internal feedback deadlines, consolidate interviews, share the timeline from day one.
Orange slide with the white Retailworld logo: Hiring now? Get there first. List a vacancy with our specialist retail team. Link in bio.
